summary: This Form 6-K reports that Mingteng International Corp Inc. entered into a Waiver Agreement and a Registration Rights Agreement with purchasers of Class A ordinary shares from a prior Securities Purchase Agreement. The Waiver lifts a 180-day lock-up restriction on shares held by those purchasers. The Registration Rights Agreement commits the company to file a resale registration statement (Form F-1 or F-3) within 180 days and keep it effective until all covered shares can be freely sold. This is a routine follow-up to a prior PIPE financing, not a standalone special situation.
